title: A Meridian scenario's text and numbers (rules/scenarios/<id>.json)

announcement.description: Read aloud by Tiller when the scenario begins. Public: no secret. At most 60 words.

tokens.description: Each token kind the scenario places: its placeholder look on the TV. A kind must look the same in every scenario.

counters.description: Each counter's TV label, or null to keep it off the TV. A key ending in '-' is a prefix for per-seat counters; '{seat}' in its label is the seat's name.

votes.description: The question each of the scenario's votes asks on the phones, by the vote's purpose.

name.description: Shown on the TV's HUD ('Prize carried by Sam'). Default: the kind, capitalised.

monster.description: Walks like crew on the TV.
